Subject: Randolph Project Noise Study

Dear Alan:
Enclosed is a print of our map showing the locations on the site for which computer calculations were made. The lines which run approximately normal to the roadway are labeled numerically (e.g. 1, 2, 3, etc.). The "x"s indicate the calculation points and are designated by letters (e.g. A, B, C, etc.), with "A" for each line being the "x" closest to the roadway. The illustrative locations which we used in our report (Figures 1, 2 and 3) were 1B, 7E, and 13F. We have circled these three locations in red on the map.
